_comment: Prompt budgets for ECON 8310 (Fall 2026). Keys match the submission folder stem, the commit-message prefix, and the --homework argument to scripts/validate_submission.py. Multi-part assignments carry one entry per part, because each part is submitted separately and has its own budget.
_required_files_note: REPORT.md is required by every assignment except hw05_part1 and hw05_part2, but the validator applies required_submission_files globally, so it is not listed here. Check REPORT.md when grading those nine.
